title: When the World Lies: Backdoor Attacks on Latent World Models for Downstream Control
abstract: arXiv:2609.15781v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pretrained world models, learned simulators that encode an observation into a latent state and predict how it evolves under actions, are beginning to be reused as off-the-shelf dynamics backbones for control, like pretrained encoders and language models are reused today. We show that this reuse opens a supply-chain backdoor: an adversary who controls only a released checkpoint can hijack the downstream controller, even though the victim trains and evaluates entirely on clean data and never sees the trigger. The attack encodes no explicit trigger-to-action rule. Instead, the poisoned model routes trigger-bearing observations into a chosen latent region and reshapes the local dynamics there, so that the victim's own optimization (Dreamer-style actor training in imagination, or MPC/CEM planning over predicted futures) re-discovers the attacker's target action on its own. translated_title: 当世界撒谎时：针对下游控制的潜在世界模型后门攻击
translated_abstract: 预训练世界模型——一种将观测编码为潜在状态并预测其在动作驱动下如何演化的学习型模拟器——正开始像如今的预训练编码器和语言模型一样，被重复用作控制任务的现成动力学骨干。我们证明这种重复使用会引入一种供应链后门：仅需控制已发布的模型检查点，攻击者就能劫持下游控制器，即使受害者完全在干净数据上进行训练和评估，且从未见过触发器。该攻击不编码任何显式的触发器-动作规则。相反，被投毒的模型会将带有触发器的观测引导至选定的潜在区域，并重塑该区域的局部动力学，使得受害者自身的优化过程（基于想象的Dreamer风格actor训练，或基于预测未来的MPC/CEM规划）自行重新发现攻击者的目标动作。在多个控制任务和触发器类型上，触发器引导……
tldr: 本文揭示了一种针对预训练世界模型的新型供应链后门攻击：攻击者只需在发布的模型检查点中植入后门，即可让完全使用干净数据训练的下游控制器在自身优化过程中自行“发现”攻击者的目标动作。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a novel supply-chain backdoor attack on pretrained world models, where an adversary who controls only a released checkpoint can hijack downstream controllers trained entirely on clean data, making the victim's own optimization autonomously rediscover the attacker's target action.
